title: Glowing key
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='35%' cy='35%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fffbe0'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#ffd54a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e6a800'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='halo' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe066' stop-opacity='0.45'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#ffb300' stop-opacity='0.15'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb300' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- soft glow halo -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='34' r='40' fill='url(#halo)'/>

  <!-- key ring -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='32' r='18' fill='none' stroke='#ffd54a' stroke-width='9'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='32' r='18' fill='none' stroke='#fff3a8' stroke-width='3' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- key shaft -->
  <rect x='48' y='28' width='34' height='8' rx='4' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <rect x='50' y='29' width='30' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#fff6b0' opacity='0.85'/>

  <!-- shaft highlight end cap -->
  <circle cx='82' cy='32' r='4' fill='#fffbe0'/>

  <!-- key teeth -->
  <rect x='66' y='34' width='7' height='13' rx='2' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <rect x='76' y='34' width='7' height='9' rx='2' fill='#fff0a0'/>
  <rect x='66' y='36' width='7' height='3' rx='1' fill='#fff6b0' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- warm reflection on ring -->
  <path d='M24 20 Q30 15 38 19' fill='none' stroke='#fffbe0' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- sparkle dots -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='58' r='2' fill='#fffbe0'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='20' r='1.6' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='56' r='1.8' fill='#fff6b0'/>
  <circle cx='12' cy='16' r='1.4' fill='#ffd54a'/>
</svg>
